name: Durg

queries.query: दुर्ग छत्तीसगढ़ भू नक्शा तहसील दुर्ग जमीन नक्शा आधिकारिक
queries.scope: Confirm the local revenue/cadastral map service and whether full vectors are public.
queries.result: The Durg District Administration land-map page routes residents to the state Revenue Department. The state BhuNaksha viewer has public district/tehsil/RI/village selectors, and the public API returns a Durg district selector (code 43) and Durg tehsil (code 01) with map data. Client source renders village and selected plots through WMS image layers; no full parcel-vector endpoint was exposed in the inspected code.
queries.executionMethod: Separate Hindi-language search, official Durg district page, public viewer HTML/JS, and anonymous administrative selector requests only. No plot detail or owner fields requested.

queries.query: Durg Chhattisgarh cadastral parcel map official BhuNaksha land records public GIS
queries.scope: Cross-check local registry evidence, map coverage, and vector availability.
queries.result: The official district page identifies Bhuiyan/BhuNaksha as the route for land record and cadastral-map services. The Government of India DILRMP dashboard lists Durg tehsils and digitized cadastral-map status; the local public viewer itself uses WMS images, not returned full geometries. No full polygon sample was verified.
queries.executionMethod: Separate English-language search with first-party district and state viewer inspection plus read-only public selector metadata.
